title: Professor of Public Policy
bio: Dara Kay Cohen is a political scientist and Professor of Public Policy at the John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University. Her research and teaching interests include the causes and consequences of civil war and other forms of political violence, gender and conflict, and qualitative and mixed research methods.
